classification.difficultyReason: Use exact ratios in two connected right triangles and rationalise denominators.

content.prompt: Find the exact values of $a$ and $x$.

spec.description: Triangle with an interior perpendicular altitude. The dimension arrow extends only from the altitude foot to the right vertex. Ordinary source blue geometry is rendered in house black.
spec.mathematics: Left base angle 60 degrees; right base angle 30 degrees; altitude perpendicular to the horizontal base; left sloping side x cm; right sloping side a cm; right base segment 20 cm.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens are visible; no calculated altitude or side lengths are shown.

answer.worked:
Let the perpendicular altitude be $h$ cm. In the right-hand triangle,
$$\begin{align*}
\cos30^\circ&=\frac{20}{a}\\
a&=\frac{20}{\sqrt3/2}\\
a&=\frac{40\sqrt3}{3},\\
h&=20\tan30^\circ\\
h&=\frac{20\sqrt3}{3}.
\end{align*}$$
In the left-hand triangle,
$$\begin{align*}
\sin60^\circ&=\frac{h}{x}\\
x&=\frac{20\sqrt3/3}{\sqrt3/2}\\
x&=\frac{40}{3}.
\end{align*}$$
